experiments.status: WHAT FORBIDS THE CP PHASE (O5). T1: the 32-D module of Cl(10,0) is of REAL (Majorana) type - the intertwiner between the module and its conjugate is unique (nullity 1, rank 32), Q h Q^dag = h^* to 1.0e-15 for the 10 generators (and Q T Q^dag = -T^* for the 45, to 1.5e-15), the step to 7.4e-16, and J = Q^dag K has J^2 = +1.000: this is the content of Cl(10,0) ~ M_32(R), i.e. Spin(10) lands in SO(32), and a real form of U(32) carries no CP-odd invariant. T2: the real form is a CHOICE of root - the complex algebra is the same for all 11 signatures p+q=10 and the Frobenius-Schur indicator is +1 for p-q = 0,2 mod 8 and -1 for p-q = 4,6 mod 8 (validated on Cl(2,0) ~ M_2(R) and Cl(0,2) ~ H): Cl(8,2), Cl(7,3), Cl(4,6), Cl(3,7), Cl(0,10) are quaternionic. T3: the mirror is not a privilege of reality - on the quaternionic root Cl(7,3) (J^2 = -1.000) the 21 mixed even products h'_a h'_b (a < 3 <= b) are Hermitian traceless involutions (squared to I to 0.0e+00, traceless to 0.0e+00) generating an exactly unitary step (6.7e-16) with det U = 1 whose spectrum is still exactly conjugation-closed (2.9e-15). The naive mechanism fails on BOTH roots: the intertwiner inverts every single factor (J F J^-1 = F^-1) but reverses the order of the ordered product, so J U J^-1 != U^-1 (dev 5.8e-01 for Cl(7,3), 8.1e-01 for Cl(10,0)) - the mirror is a property of the whole ordered step, not of a one-factor symmetry. T4: the pairing is a ONE-CELL statement - the implemented 128-level Floquet spectrum at generic Bloch momentum is not conjugation-closed at all (0.99), while the one-cell 32 spectrum is exact (3.0e-15); and a complex bond layer (Peierls flux) leaves unitarity and |det| = 1 at machine precision while the gauge-invariant plaquette holonomy acquires Im = 0.217. VERDICT: the CP prohibition is a property of the real form of the on-site algebra plus the real democratic Yukawa - it is not a theorem of the automaton. The mirror it leans on survives any real form (T3), it does not extend to the band spectrum (T4), and it does not cover the bond layer, where V105 locates the kappa_s and where a gauge-invariant CP-odd quantity is available as a named input.

experiments.status: TANGENT VELOCITIES AND NODE LITTLE GROUPS (O9). T1: measured exactly, not at a finite radius, the 12 V63 doubler nodes have tangent speeds along the three axes (0.00000, 0.14189, 0.14189) - one axis direction is exactly flat, the other two carry equal speeds; V115's finite-difference velocities converge as dq -> 0 (exponent 0.00 on a linear branch, -1.00 on the flat one, i.e. a quadratic gap), so the anisotropy is NOT a dq = 1e-3 artifact. T2: the nodes sit at zone-EDGE momenta whose little group is C2v - two equal velocities and a free third, exactly what is measured - while the supercell zone CORNER (pi/2,pi/2,pi/2) carries exactly 3-fold degenerate multiplets (splitting < 1e-12): the full octahedral group is realised there. T3: the V65 Wilson factor drives a corner cubic TRIPLET exactly gapless (gap 1.2e-10 and 7.1e-11 at independent (theta,w) points) - the first exactly massless cubic multiplet found in the model, a one-parameter family. T4: on that subspace dM/dq_j is anti-hermitian (err 1.5e-10) and the velocity operators S_j = i dM/dq_j are nonzero (max speed 0.922 in lattice units): the touching IS linear, not quadratic. T4b: but the three velocity operators COMMUTE (max ||[S_i,S_j]|| = 2.5e-12) and sum_j S_j^2 is a scalar - the three branches carry three FIXED velocity vectors, so the node is a crossing of three NODAL PLANES, not a cone: the 6588 branch-directions span [1.5e-03, 0.922], 36 of them are exactly gapless, and every branch speed equals |v_alpha . d| to 6.1e-12 - the node is three planes. VERDICT: the failure of continuous Lorentz invariance is structural, not a tuning failure. A cone requires the tangent velocity operators to close a Clifford-type algebra; in the implemented step they commute, because the bond layer is a Kronecker product (cell index) x (internal algebra) and never mixes the two. Closing O9 requires a bond layer that entangles the cell and internal indices.

experiments.status: THE MASSLESS SPIN CONTENT AND THE DISPERSION OF THE STEP (F4). The step factorises exactly as M(q) = kron(P(q), U16^6) (4.9e-15), so any cubic symmetry acts on the 8-dimensional bond factor alone and the internal 16 is inert. VERDICT: all three clauses of F4 are realised in the implemented step. The graviton is not in this one-particle spectrum: the classical GR limit claimed in Section 9 is a statement about the coarse-grained geometry, and F4 must be read as a requirement on a sector the implementation does not yet contain.

experiments.status: THE DRESSED GAUGE GATE ON THE DIRECTED-LINK NETWORK, AND THE QUINTET DISPERSION. Part A (the V79 open step, split by computation): the directed-link Gauss charge closes ONLY with the conjugate head convention (tail +L, head -Lbar) - the naive chain sign convention leaks 4.8e+00 on the two-link star (T1); the bare bond gate leaks the vertex charge 7.55 (T2); the Kogut-Susskind ELECTRIC gate exp(i g10 C_x^2) is exactly gauge-invariant (max over all 45 charges 2.5e-14) and its spectrum IS the V79 content theorem, phases g10 x {45, 85, 117} with multiplicities 32, 288, 1120 (T3); every two-site dressed-hopping candidate on the fixed adjoint link leaks (min 1.25e+01) - the invariant hopping needs a regular-representation link (T4). Part B (the V138 T5 escape route, run): on the directional network the flux is the link orientation (a c-number), the dressed hop exists exactly, and the step M(q) = exp(-i g10 sin(q).J) is unitary and O_h-covariant (improper elements invert the step: the network is chiral, T5). At GAMMA it is the identity: six gapless bands with content A1g + Eg + T2g - the quintet is present where the qubit link never had Eg (T6). Its dispersion is massless, linear (exponent 1.00), EXACTLY isotropic to leading order (direction spread O(eps^2)), with the helicity ladder speeds {0, g10, 2 g10} - the m = 0 branch and the A1g trace do not propagate - and UV-bounded by 2 g10 sqrt(3) (T7). VERDICT: the directional bond layer supplies the kinematics the qubit link was proved not to have (V138: no Eg, flat bands; V139: anisotropy 0.857): a massless, linear, isotropic quintet at the zone centre. What is NOT derived: the directional network's gauge group is the lattice direction group O_h, not Spin(10); the Spin(10)-invariant dressed hopping is obstructed on the fixed adjoint link (T4); the ladder speeds g10 x {1,2} = {0.2, 0.4} are not 1 (the dressing angle per hop is an input); the coupling of the quintet to the matter layer and the non-linear completion are not constructed.

experiments.status: THE GAUGED BOND LAYER HAS NO ONE-BODY PHYSICAL STATES; ITS PHYSICAL SECTOR IS AN ENTANGLED MATTER-FLUX COMPLEX. (1) CENTER OBSTRUCTION: dim ker = 0 for 32 x 45, for 32 x 45 x 45, and for the two-site one-link chain with LOCAL Gauss constraints - adjoint flux carries even center charge and cannot screen a spinor, so EVERY site must carry an even number of spinors: the implemented one-32-per-site content admits NO gauge-invariant state on any graph. (2) MINIMAL PHYSICAL SECTOR: two matter fields per site: m_45(32 x 32) = 2 (C2 spectrum), intertwiner space dim 2, glued two-site sector dim 4, all exact Spin(10) singlets (C2 < 1e-8). The quadratic step of V97 cannot produce any of this: the gauged layer is where the theory first gets non-Gaussian entanglement. Open (O9): multi-bond clusters (3-site, 2-link with paired matter is 2 x 10^10 dimensional) - the additivity of ln 45 per cut bond is a structural argument, not yet a measured scaling.

experiments.status: THE AREA LAW OF THE GAUGED LAYER HAS A VERTEX CORRECTION, AND THE BEKENSTEIN GAP IS A NAMED NUMBER. (1) The physical sector of the three-site, two-link chain with paired matter is dim ker = 24 (predicted 24 = m_45^2 x (m_1 N_1 + m_45 N_45 + m_210 N_210) = 4 x 6 from the measured flux decomposition of 45 x 45; links are adjoint-only, r labels the fusion channel at the middle vertex). (2) Constructed exactly: in the r = 1 sector (8 states) the middle pair is a product singlet (S(pair2|rest) = 0) while the end pairs stay entangled at ln 45 - the flux line threads through the chain; the r = 45 sector (8 states) is built from the V98 intertwiners and the adjoint Clebsch f_{gab} (vertex Gauss residual 3.7e-15). (3) ADDITIVITY HOLDS ACROSS A SINGLE BOND: S(pair1|rest) = ln 45 exactly. BUT the region with TWO boundary bonds carries S(pair2|rest) = ln 45, not 2 ln 45: the intertwiner constraint CORRELATES the two bonds meeting at the vertex (mutual information ln 45). The area law counts bonds; vertex correlations subtract - the subleading correction of the gauged layer, computed. (4) THE GAP TO BEKENSTEIN, AS A NUMBER: ln 45 = 3.80666 nats per Planck bond against 1/4 per Planck area: deficit 3.55666 nats, factor 15.2266. No element of the current construction produces 1/4; closing it needs either a superselection/truncation of the flux or a different horizon microstate count - named, open.
